title: 第一卷 第2章 暮年入道，举世嘲讽
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
青玄宗两名修士相视对望，眼中皆是纠结与迟疑。

    收，还是不收？

    不收！

    这是千年一遇的极品天灵根，放弃此等仙苗，便是整个青玄宗的损失，日后若是被其他宗门得知，必会沦为笑柄。

    可收！

    一个百岁老翁，寿元将尽，经脉全堵，根本无法修行。耗费宗门资源，最终也只是徒劳，纯属累赘。

    两难抉择，难以决断。

    良久，年长的女修咬了咬牙，沉声开口：

    “逆天灵根，千载难逢，不可错失。规矩是死的，人是活的，破例一次，带他回山，交由宗门长老定夺！”

    极品天灵根的诱惑力，足以让人打破所有常规。

    哪怕只有万分之一的可能，他们也不愿放弃。

    年轻女修虽满心不解，却也只能点头应允。

    随即，一道轻柔灵力裹住苏玄尘衰老的身躯，腾空而起，踏云升空。

    百年凡人，苏玄尘第一次脱离大地，凌空俯瞰世间。

    脚下山川河流飞速倒退，风声在耳畔呼啸，云海苍茫，天地壮阔。

    百年来扎根凡尘的桎梏，在此刻悄然碎裂一角。

    苏玄尘静静俯瞰云海，心中百感交集。

    八十二年的遗憾，八十二年的不甘，终于在百岁这年，迎来了一丝转机。

    白芷，当年你以仙凡有别弃我而去。

    今日我入仙门，他日我登临巅峰，定要让你知晓，凡人暮年，亦可逆天！

    半个时辰后。

    巍峨群山之巅，一座悬浮于云海之上的恢弘仙门，映入眼帘。
content_en:
The two monks of Qingxuan Sect looked at each other with confusion and hesitation in their eyes.

    To accept or not to accept?

    Not accepted!

    This is the best heavenly spirit root that can be found once in a thousand years. Giving up such immortal seedlings will be a loss for the entire Qingxuan Sect. If other sects find out about it in the future, they will definitely become a laughing stock.

    Available!

    A 100-year-old man is about to expire and his meridians are all blocked, making him unable to practice at all. Spending the sect's resources will ultimately be in vain and purely a burden.

    Dilemma, difficult decision.

    After a long time, the older female cultivator gritted her teeth and spoke in a deep voice:

    "The heaven-defying spiritual root is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, don't miss it. Rules are dead, people are alive. Make an exception. Take him back to the mountain and leave it to the elders of the sect to make a decision!"

    The allure of the best Tianlinggen is enough to make people break all conventions.

    Even if there is only one chance in ten thousand, they are not willing to give up.

    Although the young female cultivator was puzzled, she could only nod in agreement.

    Immediately, a gentle spiritual energy wrapped around Su Xuanchen's aging body, soared into the sky, and stepped on the clouds.

    For the first time in a hundred years as a mortal, Su Xuanchen left the earth and looked down at the world from the sky.

    The mountains and rivers beneath our feet are retreating rapidly, the wind is whistling in our ears, the sea of ​​clouds is vast, and the sky and earth are vast.

    The shackles that have been rooted in the mortal world for hundreds of years are quietly shattered at this moment.

    Su Xuanchen looked down at the sea of ​​clouds quietly, with mixed feelings in his heart.

    Eighty-two years of regret, eighty-two years of unwillingness, and finally, at the age of 100, a slight turning point came.

    Bai Zhi, back then you abandoned me because you were different from immortals to mortals.

    Today I enter the Immortal Sect, and I will reach the pinnacle tomorrow. I must let you know that even in old age, mortals can defy the heavens!

    Half an hour later.

    On the top of the towering mountains, a magnificent fairy gate suspended above the sea of ​​clouds came into view.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 2 Entering Taoism in his later years, ridiculed by the whole world
